column5: What the role "EC2 Instance Profile" is used for in regards to ECS?
column6:
EC2 Instance Profile used by ECS agent on an EC2 instance to:

  * Make API calls to ECS Service
  * Send logs to CloudWatch from the container
  * Use secrets defined in SSM Parameter Store or Secrets Manager
  * Pull container images from ECR (Registry)

column5: Explain what is CloudFormation
column6: AWS definition: "AWS CloudFormation is a service that helps you model and set up your Amazon Web Services resources so that you can spend less time managing those resources and more time focusing on your applications that run in AWS. You create a template that describes all the AWS resources that you want (like Amazon EC2 instances or Amazon RDS DB instances), and CloudFormation takes care of provisioning and configuring those resources for you."\n\nRemember: CloudFormation = AWS-native IaC. Templates (JSON/YAML) define stacks. Drift detection shows manual changes. Rollback on failure by default.

column5: You would like to run an AWS Fargate task every time a file is uploaded to a certain S3 bucket. How would you achieve that?
column6:
Use Amazon EventBridge so every time a file is uploaded to an S3 bucket (event) it will run an ECS task.

Such task should have an ECS Task Role so it can get the object from the S3 bucket (and possibly other permissions if it needs to update the DB for example).
